scope: BLOCKER-BILLING-001. The billing consumer interface and server enforcement: configured prices/purchase types, recorded access state, renewal behavior, at-period-end cancellation (access continues, no refund/termination claimed), the once-only upgrade credit, and account isolation. Implementation is closed by ba-consumer-billing; staging verification is pending.

tests.expected: configured price, currency and purchase type are returned and shown before checkout
tests.measured: report_once CAD 5.95 one_time, monthly CAD 7.95 month, annual CAD 79.50 year; the Billing step renders each plan price/currency and purchase type

tests.expected: one-time purchases do not imply recurring billing; recurring products show their actual renewal
tests.measured: a one-time plan is labelled "one-time purchase"; a subscription shows "renews automatically" with its plan

tests.expected: cancellation works at period end without implying a refund or immediate termination
tests.measured: POST /api/entitlement/cancel sets cancel_at_period_end and entitled stays true; the UI shows "Cancel renewal" only for a subscription

tests.expected: the configured once-only CAD 5.95 upgrade credit is shown and enforced
tests.measured: a verified one-time payment earns an ELIGIBLE 595-cent credit; the UI shows "CAD 5.95" only when eligible

tests.expected: billing views and actions are authenticated and account-scoped
tests.measured: unauthenticated -> 401; a different account sees only its own entitlement; a no-purchase account cannot cancel
